name: StackRates hosting price index
note: Each row carries the date and method its price was read. Prices are provider list prices in USD per month; a provider that bills in euros has its euro price in billed_eur, one that bills in pounds its pound price in billed_gbp, converted at the ECB rate in fx (usdPerGbp is the ECB cross rate). ipv4_extra_usd is what a public IPv4 address adds to monthly_usd: Hetzner and netcup print their prices with the address included (monthly_usd + ipv4_extra_usd is the printed price), and every other provider with an ipv4_extra_usd bills it on top of the price it prints. Confirm at source_url before buying. Only plans that can be ordered today: plans the provider shows as sold out, and automatic prices not re-read for 7 days, are left out.
